parameters.name: DeleteListener
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to remove the configured listeners. Valid values:

*   true: removes the configured listeners.
*   false: does not remove the configured listeners.

parameters.name: SlbId
parameters.description: The ID of the SLB instance.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The network type of the SLB instance. Valid values:

*   **internet**: Internet-facing SLB instance
*   **intranet**: internal-facing SLB instance

example.unifiedCli: aliyun edas unbind-slb --app-id c627c157-560d-00000000000000000000 --slb-id lb-wz9vo490000000000000000 --type internet --delete-listener false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun edas POST /pop/app/unbind_slb_json --region cn-hangzhou --SlbId 'lb-wz9vo490000000000000000' --Type internet --AppId 'c627c157-560d-00000000000000000000' --DeleteListener false --header "Content-Type=application/json"
